name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Optus-X/TD7
description: An unannounced geostationary communication satellite built by Northrop Grumman, alleged for the Australian telecommunications operator Optus. Details TBD.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 first stage B1077 has landed on ASDS ASOG after its 16th flight.
